title: Bloemgracht 82, the resistance attic raided ten days before liberation
check_note: The register records a 1945 stone with the names Dick Wolters and Ko Stevesen; the 2014 stone gives the right names. Is the old stone still there beside it?

title: De Vorstenlanden, Eduard Huf's cigar shop in the Zoutsteeg
check_note: Still Kadinsky (own site, Nov 2026), as Café Zoutsteeg or 'Kadinsky Sessions' at no. 9. Which, and how legible the beam lettering is, needs a look.

title: Geldersekade 105 and the raid of 26 May 1943
check_note: Joods Monument (2024) dates the raid photo 25 or 26 May 1943; the couple died on 21 May, so it cannot show their arrest. Match the houses in the photo on site.

title: Hofje Venetiae
check_note: Check the name at the street door, Elandsstraat 106: VENETIA cut in big letters, or an enamel VENETIAE plate (seen in 2025)?

title: Kas-Associatie, two cashiers' banks and an elephant clock
check_note: Confirm the elephant clock, the Mercury statue and the De Distel tile panel are still in the hall now that it is The Duchess.

title: Kettner's piano shop, with its wares in tiles
check_note: The shop is a Nespresso boutique (nespresso.com, Nov 2026). Still to check on site: whether the firm's name still stands in the ridge railing.

title: Maison Stroucken, the party hall inside DeLaMar
check_note: Gebouwd in Amsterdam says the front is partly a replica; no source (searched 24 Nov 2026) says whether the winged dog and the stair turrets were rebuilt. Needs a look on site.

title: Pakketpostgebouw, the parcel machine beside Centraal Station
check_note: Now Gebouw De Oost, still NS-owned; front restored to its original look (2024). What is inside (probably railway offices) is not confirmed.

title: Rozengracht bridges and the tram to Zandvoort
check_note: Bridge 167 renovated; 117 partly open since 26 Oct 2026 (AT5), trams 1 Mar 2027, done by 2029; 63 unfinished end 2025 (Mobilis). Is the rail stub on 167 still there?

title: Two schools on the old Leidse cemetery
check_note: Draft permit of Sept 2025 for 10 homes, work space and a car park on the old playground; current use of the school building still unknown.

title: Zuid-Afrikahuis, the library whose books were thrown in the canal
check_note: Library open Mon, Tue, Thu 10:00-16:00 (own site, Nov 2026). Whether the eagle of about 1620 is still visible over the door, and which floor the reading room is on, needs a visit.

title: De Naaister and the corn measure, Bergstraat
check_note: The pin is at Bergstraat 6; place the statue exactly on site.

title: Hoogte Kadijk, the old sea dike and its last shipyard
check_note: Gable stone house numbers from the gable stone lists; confirm Koorn Aaren and Udinck on the spot.

title: Leidse Dwarstuin, a walled garden in the tourist strip
check_note: Pin at the address of the garden gate (Lange Leidsedwarsstraat 152); exact entrance to confirm.

title: Lindengracht, the filled canal and the eel riot
check_note: The pin is on the Lindengracht; where exactly the Zaterdagse brug crossed, and so where the eel hung, is not settled.

title: Nieuwezijds Kapel, the Holy Place inside a shopping block
check_note: en.wikipedia puts the chapel remains in the Enge Kapelsteeg, nl.wikipedia names both alleys; no photo or text found that pins the gate (search 24 Nov 2026). Settle on site.

title: Noordermarkt: the post, the plaque and the outline in the paving
check_note: The pin is on the Woutertje Pieterse statue; the water-tap post stands near it.

title: Prinseneiland: the last tar winch, the Palmentuin and Mandela's garden
check_note: Pin on the quay by the Sloterdijkerbrug; confirm the exact spot of the winch cover, and that the Mandela mural (last photographed 2021 and 2022) is still there.

title: The Shaffyboom, a maple that swallowed the railway fence
check_note: Not in the city tree register: it stands on ProRail land (tree advice Centrum, Apr 2024), so no register point. Pin on the tree on the railway bank, seen from the Dijksgracht; confirm on site.

title: The floating gardens of Robert Jasper Grootveld, Wittenburgervaart
check_note: The rafts lie near the Ezelsbrug, diagonally opposite the Bandenboot; pin approximate on the water.

title: The poor-relief bakery on the burned theatre's site
check_note: The register point lies inside the block, reached by the alley beside no. 495; whether the front with the time verse can be seen from a public spot was not checked.

title: The stumbling threshold at the Artis tram stop (Plantage Middenlaan)
check_note: The threshold lies at the Artis tram stop on the Plantage Middenlaan; which platform and the exact spot are not confirmed.

title: Tuin Bickersgracht Noordkop and children's farm De Dierencapel
check_note: Pin on the farm entrance; the exact edge of the neighbours' garden beside the skate ramp to be confirmed on site.

title: Waterline, a red figure on the quay wall
check_note: Pin approximate; place the figure exactly and confirm it is still there.

title: Catharinahofje, Egelantiersgracht (former)
check_note: Is the Vierhuizengang under the stoops of nos. 203-213 still open? One source says it vanished with the new building, the city's alley map still lists it.

title: De Aardige Amsterdammer, a hand for the volunteers
check_note: The hand was reported damaged in May 2024; whether it has been repaired is not known.

title: Lifeboat shed on the Windroosplein
check_note: Reopened Oct 2026 as event venue Amsterdam Wharf after a full rebuild (amsterdamwharf.nl, Nov 2026). Is the society's painted name still on both walls?

title: Olieslagerssteeg, the lepers' house, the oil pressers and Maison de Bonneterie
check_note: 4en5mei.nl (Nov 2026) still puts the plaque in the stairwell of the Rokin store, now an H&M. Whether it is still there is not known.

title: Sint Luciënsteeg, the gable stone wall
check_note: Works began 3 Sept 2026; NH Nieuws reports monumental parts being boarded over for protection. Whether the gable stone wall is screened, and the exact pin on the stones, still to check on site.

title: The Russensjoel and the old "Jodenkerkstraat" (Nieuwe Kerkstraat 149)
check_note: Not among the synagogues listed by the NIHS, Amsterdam's Ashkenazi community (nihs.nl, Nov 2026); the latest service listing found is from 2004. Whether it still holds services is unconfirmed.

title: The harmonica player of the Anjeliersstraat, by a sculptor nobody names
check_note: The latest dated mention of the harmonica player is from 2017; confirm it and which small figures still hang in the street.

title: The one-of-a-kind cable box in the Langestraat
check_note: Listed in 2013; no recent report that the box is still on the pavement, and whether Zimmer's name is visible was not checked.

title: Tjerk Hiddesschool, the school children fought over and Constant's studio
check_note: Current use after Constant's death (2005) not found; his studio was cleared in 2008 per Stichting Constant.

title: Volkskoffiehuis on the Kadijksplein
check_note: SOTTO closed May 2026; a Pizza Giuseppe listed at no. 4 is unconfirmed. Check what opens there and whether the Volksbond name is still on the front.
